parameters.name: MediaIds
parameters.description:
The media IDs, which are audio or video IDs (VideoId). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 IDs are supported. You can obtain the IDs by using the following methods:
- For audio or video files uploaded through the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the audio or video ID.
- When you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain the upload URL and credential, the video ID is the value of the VideoId response parameter.
- After the audio or video file is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter.

parameters.name: MediaType
parameters.description: The media type. Set the value to **video** (audio/video).
